operating_rules.if_receiver_vacuum: keep boundary shut while serviced-side gallery remains pressurised; isolate and deliberately cycle a compatible local transfer volume or use an exterior route under permit
operating_rules.if_receiver_toxic_or_incompatible: keep boundary shut even at equal pressure unless secondary containment, exhaust capture and compatible transfer are established
operating_rules.if_indicator_disagrees_with_local_gauge: do not open; test instrumentation and physical seal
operating_rules.cargo_sector_dual_entry_rule: both gallery personnel hatch and freight handling gate are separately pressure rated; neither may bypass the other via the shared receiving sector
operating_rules.opening_a_rated_gate: does not create an atmosphere source or make an unknown space breathable
